items.reason: In packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleSMSReminders.ts:111-121, profile and URL lookups execute inside the same try block as scheduling, and the new catch increments retryCount at lines 189-195 even when those lookups fail before Twilio runs. Two such failures make the reminder eligible for deletion at lines 29-40, permanently dropping an unsent reminder.

The error logging at packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleSMSReminders.ts:198 is identical to the base commit; this PR adds only the retry-count update before it. Any sensitive information exposed through that existing log is therefore not introduced or changed by this PR.
